EP-e2988d0f1e.summary: Create a book in the in-memory catalog.
EP-e2988d0f1e.behavior: The POST /v1/books endpoint creates a new book in the in-memory catalog. The book is saved in the `BOOKS` dictionary with the id of the book as the key and a dictionary representing the book as its value. The response contains a 201 status code and a JSON response describing the created book.
limitations: The book title must be between 1 and 120 characters.
